name: material-mundi
description: Material Mundi — Turn Waste Into Value. A secure MERN marketplace for waste material sourcing and processed material sales.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
